name: Watkins Glen International
summary: 1971-1974 F1 layout (historic); elevation good; corners under-banked by 2-3 deg against the lidar

layout.gameLayout: Grand Prix Circuit with the Boot, no Inner Loop (5.435 km): the F1 layout of 1971-1974 (1975-1980 F1 races added the Esses chicane, removed in 1985); F1 has not raced here since 1980 (not a 2010-2026 venue)
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Watkins_Glen_International (infobox layout4 "Grand Prix Circuit (1971-1974, 1986-1991)" 5.435 km; layout5 "with Esses Chicane (1975-1985)"; Inner Loop added 1992)
OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Overpass API (maps.mail.ru mirror), cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/overpass/
layout.note: the line follows OSM within 4.5 m incl. the disused straight bypassed by the 1992 "Inner Loop" (OSM way 428026652, not followed: 135 m) - consistent with the pre-1992 length; no Esses chicane in the game

direction.source: OSM oneway raceway ways agree over 5549 m, 0 m against

pit.limitSource: F1 raced here 1961-1980, before pit lane speed limits (introduced after the 1994 San Marino GP: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pit_stop)

elevation.demUsedForReference: USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM (1 m lidar; ImageServer getSamples)
elevation.gameSource: USGS 3DEP via EPQS along the dataset centreline, DTM filters

published.value: "curling left-hand downhill through the woods ... two uphill right-hand turns, over an exciting blind crest"

famousFeatures.feature: descent after the Outer Loop / into the Boot

banking.method: lidar heights at +-4 m across the OSM centreline every 10 m; tilt = atan((hLeft - hRight) / 8 m)

findings.game: curvature-derived banking only: The Ninety 4 deg, The Esses 1.5 deg, The Esses 1.4 deg, The Esses 1.3 deg, The Esses 1.2 deg, Outer Loop 2.3 deg, The Chute 3.3 deg, The Toe 3.7 deg, The Heel 3 deg, The Fast Lefthander 2.5 deg, Turn 11 3.1 deg
findings.real: lidar cross-slope shows real superelevation in both directions (inside lower in left- and right-handers): The Ninety 6, The Esses 4.5, The Esses 4, The Esses 4.5, The Esses 4, Outer Loop 5.5, The Chute 5.5, The Toe 5.5, The Heel 5, The Fast Lefthander 4.5, Turn 11 5.5 deg; straights 0.9 deg. No published angles
findings.proposedFix: BANKED['us-1956'] = proposal.bankOverrides (measured angles; js/track.js eases 35 m in / out)
sources: USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM, 1 m lidar (public domain): https://elevation.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DEPElevation/ImageServer (getSamples), acquisition dates from https://epqs.nationalmap.gov/v1/json?...&includeDate=true

findings.real: a footbridge (OSM way 293208080, layer 1) spans the pit straight at s 5161.4 m (271.5 m before the game's line); service tunnels pass under the track at s 4512.3, 1097.6, 4921.3 m
sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Overpass API (maps.mail.ru mirror), cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/overpass/

findings.game: smooth over the service tunnels (s ~1098 and ~4512 m)
findings.real: the bare-earth lidar dips 3.3 m (s 1091-1101) and up to 5.7 m (s 4512, dataset line) where tunnels pass under the track: the DEM removed the track deck as a bridge. The build's 50 m median already rejects them (game rms vs lidar 0.28 m)
sources: USGS 3DEP bare-earth DEM, 1 m lidar (public domain): https://elevation.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DEPElevation/ImageServer (getSamples), acquisition dates from https://epqs.nationalmap.gov/v1/json?...&includeDate=true

findings.real: OSM "Pit Lane" ways 50289311 + 20164027 on the right from s -274.5 to +527.9 m (rejoins after the 90). No pit speed limit existed in F1 before 1994
findings.proposedFix: side right; 80 km/h is the game-wide default
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pit_stop (pit lane speed limits introduced in F1 after the 1994 San Marino GP)

findings.real: no start / finish node in OSM; the line was moved 380 ft (116 m) towards the 90 in 2006, the 1971-1980 position is not mapped
